name: Market-1501
description: Person re-identification dataset with 1,501 identities and about 32,000 bounding boxes. Common evaluation metrics include mAP and Rank-1 accuracy. Use is subject to the Tsinghua release terms; no dataset data is vendored here.
citation: Market-1501: A Dataset and Benchmark for Person Re-Identification. Zheng et al., ICCV 2015.
